tagline.en_US: Run Jaeger’s all-in-one image for collecting OTLP traces and viewing them in the web UI. This profile uses the built-in in-memory storage.

description.en_US: Jaeger is an open source distributed tracing platform. It collects trace data emitted by user applications through OpenTelemetry or Jaeger SDKs, stores the telemetry, and provides a web interface for inspection. It helps teams monitor complex architectures, analyze latency bottlenecks, and troubleshoot distributed systems across services.
